description: Phase 1A Persistence Foundation — Hardening review package

migrations.details: Versioned SQL migration file at lib/db/drizzle/0000_perpetual_rafael_vega.sql generated by drizzle-kit. Tracked in drizzle.__drizzle_migrations. No drizzle-kit push used in production path.

data_mode.details: parseDataMode() function in artifacts/sunrise-os/src/lib/dataMode.ts. Invalid/unrecognised VITE_SUNRISE_DATA_MODE blocks app with DATA_MODE_ERROR. Only 'demo' and 'production' accepted. Missing value defaults to 'demo' (explicit safe default). Production never falls back to mock on API error.

auth_boundary.details: requireIdentity middleware returns 401 when req.devIdentity is absent. devIdentityMiddleware registered only when NODE_ENV !== 'production'. Dev headers (X-Dev-Org-Id) are never read in production because the middleware that reads them is not registered.
auth_boundary.dev_behaviour: devIdentityMiddleware fills seed defaults, all requests pass

check_constraints: ck_sos_episodes_date_order — discharge_date IS NULL OR admission_date IS NULL OR discharge_date >= admission_date

sidebar_prefs.version_bump: v1->v2 prevents loading stale production displayNames
sidebar_prefs.production_mode: displayName and program stripped before localStorage write; only id + timestamps persisted
sidebar_prefs.demo_mode: displayName and program stored for demo UX quality (fictitious data only)

ua_drug_testing.classification: demo-only page (uses MOCK_PATIENTS); patient UUIDs are linkable

indexeddb_recordings.content: raw audio blobs + epoch timestamp; no structured PHI fields
indexeddb_recordings.lifecycle: transient — caller must call deleteRecording() after processing

new_test_files: authBoundary.test.ts — 5 auth boundary tests (HTTP + contract spec)

api_evidence.patients_dev_note: Dev mode returns 200 (devIdentityMiddleware fills seed defaults when headers absent). 401 fires only in NODE_ENV=production.

known_limitations: Interactive patient-list and patient-detail screenshots require a human login flow (SPA state-based navigation). The demo-mode login screen with orange banner is captured.

drizzle-kit migrate could not apply the full migration file (other tables already existed). DDL was applied via psql with correct index-before-FK ordering. Migration is registered in drizzle.__drizzle_migrations.
Phase 2 authentication (real JWT/session tokens) has not been implemented — /api/v1 is 401-only in production until Phase 2.
